name: Bumps & Brews
source:
Bumps & Brews is a bartending simulation about surrogacy, friendship, and the peculiar, sometimes hectic lives of Bay Point's citizens.

Immerse yourself in a world where a genetic mutation known as the 'Gift' shapes the lives of its 'Gifted' inhabitants, leading to sudden changes in their body proportions.

This game is about Dina, a Gifted woman working as a bartender at the Brewed Awakening. Dina's Gift manifests as most others, allowing her to adjust her body proportions, but it also has a rare, unique quirk that most people don't have: she can go through a full-term pregnancy in just a week.

Follow Dina during her surrogacy journey as you prepare drinks for ecclectic customers, build friendships, and are introduced to a colourful cast of unique and distinct characters.

[From [url=https://remileah.itch.io/bumps-and-brews]itch.io[/url]]
